sentence_stem: Although many people like online shopping,
correct_completion: I prefer to buy clothes in real shops.
full_sentence: Although many people like online shopping, I prefer to buy clothes in real shops.
acceptable_variants: I still prefer shopping in person.
I like to visit local markets for clothes.

options.why_wrong: 'Because' gives a reason. 'Although' signals contrast, not cause.

options.text: so they never spend money online.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, not a contrast, and it does not match the idea of liking online shopping.

options.text: the internet is very fast in cities.
options.why_wrong: This is a true general statement, but it does not contrast with the first part of the sentence.

options.text: I prefer to buy clothes in real shops.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. Cause clauses and general facts do not complete the contrast.
translation: Birçok insan çevrimiçi alışverişi sevse de, ben giysileri gerçek mağazalardan almayı tercih ederim.
